snippet.title: "Noel the Mortal Fate Complete Edition" PV for Steam
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/850000/
■Supported Languages: Japanese / English / Simplified Chinese

■ABOUT THIS GAME
A tale of revenge involving a demon, a girl, and their companions — after seven years in the making, the full 13-season story that concluded in April 2023 is now available as an action adventure game, "Noel the Mortal Fate Complete Edition," on Steam. Seasons 1–7 fully implement enhanced cutscenes, improved UI, and additional features from the console versions, while Seasons 8 to the final chapter and the special "Season 3.5" are all included with no additional charges. This is the definitive edition of "Noël the Mortal Fate."

■STORY
In the fictional city of Laplace, noble heiress Noel Cerquetti loses everything as a consequence of a demonic contract set up against her will. Together with the powerful demon Caron, she vows revenge and gathers allies to face formidable enemies. However, the turmoil that begins in this small city eventually escalates into a massive conflict.

■About the "Noel the Mortal Fate" series
Since its debut in 2016, the series has captivated fans with its intense plot twists and unique new gameplay systems introduced in each chapter. With this Complete Pack, you can experience the entire seven-year story and its diverse mechanics from start to finish in one go.

👁️‍🗨️ Streaming Guidelines
・Streaming and monetization are fully allowed! We would greatly appreciate it if you include a link to this store page in your video description.
・Please refrain from any illegal activities or actions that may cause trouble to others.

※Please note that save data from the old PC version cannot be carried over.

Official Website ▶ https://www.gamemaga.jp/noel/
Official X ▶ https://x.com/hgyk_noel

©KANAWO / Vaka, Inc.
